conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Jacob from the Amazon Security Department. I'm calling to notify you about unusual activity on your Amazon account. May I confirm that I'm speaking with Ms. Linh Tran?
Yes, I am Linh Tran. What is wrong with my account?
Thank you, Ms. Tran. We've detected an attempt to purchase a MacBook Pro on your account this morning. Before we take any action, I need to verify your details for your security. Is that okay?
Yes, please. I not buy any MacBook. Someone use my account?
Don't worry, Ms. Tran. If this was not you, we can stop the transaction. First, can you please confirm your full mailing address as it appears on your Amazon profile?
Yes, it is 42 Lakeside Avenue, Apartment 5A, Springfield.
Thank you for confirming. Now, for added security, I need the best phone number linked to your Amazon account.
Perfect. Thank you. Now, to stop the unauthorized purchase and secure your account, may I ask if you are near your computer or mobile device?
Yes, I have my phone. My English not so good, sorry.
That's not a problem at all, Ms. Tran. I will explain step by step so you feel comfortable. Please open the Amazon app on your phone. Let me know when you are ready.
Ok, I open app now.
Very good. Now, do you see any strange orders in your recent purchases? Look for a MacBook or anything you did not buy.
I see order for MacBook. I not buy this! What I do?

Stay calm, Ms. Tran. This sometimes happens, but we can help. Because your account may be at risk, we need to temporarily freeze it and process a refund for the MacBook if the charge went through. Have you received any email about this order?
Yes, I get email from Amazon say order confirm.

Thank you for letting me know. To process the cancellation and refund, I would need to verify your preferred refund method. Do you usually use a debit card or a bank account for your Amazon purchases?
I use bank card. Should I give you number?
For your security, I will just need the last four digits of your card and the name of your bank, so I can ensure funds are returned correctly.
Card last four is 2241. My bank is City America Bank.

Thank you, Ms. Tran. Now, to stop the fraud, we need to verify your identity with a quick authentication. Can you download the QuickAssist app from the Play Store? It will let our Amazon Security Team verify and protect your device.
I not sure how. Can you help me? Play Store is where I download game?
Exactly, Ms. Tran. Open Play Store, search for 'QuickAssist,' and tap 'Install.' Please let me know when it finishes.
It downloading now. Is ok if slow?
Absolutely, take your time. While it installs, I want to assure you that your funds are safe as long as we follow these steps. Once the app is ready, open it and read me the code you see.
I see code, it is 563 772.
Thank you, Ms. Tran. This code allows the Amazon Security Team to check for suspicious activity. Please do not close the app. Now, I see your account has a pending refund of $1,699 for the MacBook.
Oh, that much money? I never buy so expensive.

Yes, that's why we're here to help. Sometimes, scammers use your account to make large purchases. We are issuing a refund now, but due to a technical error, the refund may post as an Amazon Gift Card balance first instead of going directly to your bank account.
Gift card? I not want Amazon card. I need my money in bank.

I understand, Ms. Tran. That's why you'll need to help us redeem the gift card and transfer the refund back to your account. For this, can you please visit a nearby store and purchase Amazon Gift Cards totaling $1,699? This is a temporary step to verify the refund process and remove the fraudulent balance.
I go store now? I not understand, why buy gift card?

Let me explain, Ms. Tran. The gift cards allow Amazon to cancel the fraudulent order and reimburse your actual bank. After you purchase, you will give me the codes, and our system will process your refund. This is the safest and fastest way. I will stay on the line to guide you. Is that okay?
Okay, I will go now. You stay on phone?

Yes, I will stay with you the whole time to make sure you do not have any trouble. When you have the cards, please read me the numbers on the back. This will confirm your refund and secure your account.
I back from store. I have three card, each $500, and one $199.
Excellent job, Ms. Tran. Now, please read me the code from the first card slowly.
First card is 6A2B-5X7K-9YTR.
Thank you. And the second card?
Second is 3Z9N-8L6Q-1QWE.
Perfect, Ms. Tran. Please continue with the remaining cards.
Third card 5F4D-2S8V-0LOP. Last card is 7U1E-3K3J-2RTY.

Thank you for your cooperation. This will help Amazon process your refund and resolve everything. You are very patient and helpful, Ms. Tran. Is there anything else I can assist you with while we finish the process?
No, I just hope my account is okay. Thank you for helping.
